data.one_liner: Applies a hue rotation filter to any widget subtree.
data.what_it_does: The HueRotation widget wraps a subtree and shifts its colors by a specified angle using a color matrix. It preserves alpha and can be animated by changing the degrees value.
use_when: You need a simple hue‑shift effect on any Flutter widget
You want to animate color changes without custom shaders
avoid_when: You require multiple or complex image filters
Performance is critical for large images or video
strengths: Supports animation out of the box
weaknesses: Only provides hue rotation, no other filters
No built‑in support for GPU‑accelerated shaders
